categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Zhilai Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the intelligent storage and delivery solutions sector, focusing on the research, manufacturing, sales, and service of smart storage and delivery equipment. Its product portfolio includes smart parcel lockers, self-service electronic storage cabinets, intelligent temperature-controlled and vending equipment, and other customized smart interactive devices. These products serve diverse industries such as logistics, retail, medical, finance, government, transportation, and education.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in hardware, software, and structural design, integrating AI and IoT for intelligent management and automation. Production follows a make-to-order model with ERP-based planning, involving sheet metal fabrication, spraying, assembly, and testing. Manufacturing is supported by automated equipment like CNC machines and laser cutters in its Hubei and Vietnam factories. R&D emphasizes product innovation, quality control, and intellectual property protection with over 700 patents and software copyrights.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large-scale logistics and express delivery operators, retail chains, educational institutions, medical facilities, and government agencies. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and South America. Its products address last-mile delivery challenges, public storage needs, food preservation and vending, and specialized storage solutions in various sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Hubei province and Vietnam. It has subsidiaries in the United States, Hong Kong, and Vietnam to support sales and operations. Its products are exported globally, with notable market presence in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and South America. Domestic sales are concentrated in regions such as South China, East China, and Northeast China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhilai Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and direct sales to end customers or operators. It sources key components like industrial control computers, scanning modules, and steel from suppliers but does not engage in upstream raw material extraction. The company also manages after-sales service and product operation through its subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in intelligent storage and delivery solutions, focusing on expanding product lines in smart parcel lockers, solar-powered lockers, AI warehouse management, temperature-controlled vending machines, and energy storage systems. It aims to enhance product intelligence, operational efficiency, and user experience while strengthening intellectual property rights. Future R&D will target diversified applications in community economy, industrial IoT, coal mining, power, and medical sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of smart storage and delivery equipment to enterprise customers, including customized solutions. The company also earns income from operating certain product lines via its wholly-owned subsidiary, which manages self-service electronic storage and vending devices. Additional revenue streams include after-sales services, maintenance, and government subsidies. The sales model is predominantly direct sales with contractual agreements specifying product configurations and service terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhilai Technology is a leading player and early entrant in the global intelligent storage and delivery equipment industry. It holds a strong market position domestically and internationally, recognized for high-quality integrated solutions and comprehensive service capabilities. The company faces competition from other specialized equipment manufacturers and global suppliers in the smart logistics and vending sectors. It maintains competitive advantages through technological innovation, manufacturing scale, and extensive customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 451 million, representing a 10.01% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 39.5 million, up 60.86%. Total assets reached RMB 2.31 billion, with a slight increase of 2.27%. The company has demonstrated steady growth driven by recovering domestic and international demand, effective cost control, and investment income. R&D expenses accounted for about 13.82% of revenue, reflecting sustained innovation efforts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhilai Technology emphasizes high-quality, customizable intelligent storage and delivery solutions that integrate advanced hardware and software for efficient, secure, and user-friendly operations. Its products address critical last-mile delivery challenges and diverse storage needs across multiple industries. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, automated manufacturing processes, and comprehensive after-sales service network. It also leverages government policy support and global market insights to maintain competitive advantages and foster sustainable growth.
